caseName: Lakewood Bank & Trust Co. v. Abramson
caseNameFull: LAKEWOOD BANK AND TRUST COMPANY v. Harold C. ABRAMSON

opinions.text: The motion of American Land Title Association for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae is granted. The motion of Federal National Mortgage Assn, for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae is granted. The motion of Federal Land Bank of Texas, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae is granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied.
